findings.claim: Keyboard selection of a palette command is not wired to navigation: the only selection side-effect is Autocomplete.Item's onClick (a pointer event), and Autocomplete.Root has no onValueChange/selection handler, so pressing Enter on the auto-highlighted item commits the autocomplete value instead of calling navigateTo.
findings.evidence: In the command-palette.tsx hunk, `Autocomplete.Root` receives only `open inline items itemToStringValue autoHighlight="always" keepHighlight` — no value/selection callback — and navigation exists solely in `<Autocomplete.Item ... onClick={() => navigateTo(destination)}>`. This contradicts the spec scenario 'Command navigates' (user chooses a destination command → React Router MUST navigate), the palette footer hint 'Navigate with arrow keys / Enter', acceptance task 3.4 ('keyboard auto-highlight ... close-on-navigation'), and the test 'opens the Base UI palette with Control+K and navigates with a command' which types a query and presses `{Enter}` expecting the location to become /admin/knowledge. Task 5.2 (tests/typecheck actually passing) is unchecked, consistent with this never having been exercised.
findings.suggested_fix: Handle selection on Autocomplete.Root (e.g. an onValueChange/selection callback that receives the highlighted NavigationDestination object and calls navigateTo), so keyboard Enter and pointer click share the same navigation path; keep the item onClick only as a pointer convenience.

findings.claim: Compact (≤900px) navigation removes all access to /about and /admin/runs: COMPACT_DESTINATIONS is Chat/Knowledge/Agents, the Configure sheet lists only the five configure destinations, and the desktop rail (the only surface containing About and Runs) is hidden below 901px.
findings.evidence: nav-destinations.ts sets `compactTab: true` only on chat/knowledge/agents; `runs` has no compactTab and `about` has neither compactTab nor group 'configure', so it appears in neither MobileTabBar nor MobileSheetHost's CONFIGURE_DESTINATIONS. The deleted app/navigation.ts previously exposed `{ path: "/about", label: "About" }` in the bottom bar for all narrow users, and the old bottom-bar 'Admin' link gave compact users a path into runs. The spec's compact scenario enumerates four targets but nothing in the change restores access to these two routes on compact layouts — a silent regression of reachable surface area.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a path to About (and Runs) on compact layouts — e.g. include a System section in the Configure sheet host, or a compact overflow target — or explicitly document the removal as intended in the spec.

findings.claim: aria-current="page" is applied to the Configure <button>, which is not a page or link; the 'page' token is reserved for the current page within a set of pages.
findings.evidence: mobile-tab-bar.tsx: `<button ... aria-current={configureActive ? "page" : undefined}>`; app-shell.test.tsx enshrines this (`getByRole("button", { name: /^Configure$/ })` → aria-current 'page'). For a control that opens a sheet, aria-current="true" or "location" is the conformant choice.
findings.suggested_fix: Use aria-current="true" (or move the current-state indication onto the destination link inside the sheet).

findings.claim: The apple-touch-icon points at a 256x256 PNG; Apple's expected touch-icon size is 180x180, so iOS will downscale a non-standard asset.
findings.evidence: index.html: `<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/brand/png/uar-appicon-dark-256.png" />`; the diff ships 16/32/64/128/256/512 PNG sizes but no 180px asset, and the previous icon was a dedicated 180x180 apple-touch-icon.png.
findings.suggested_fix: Generate and reference a 180x180 apple-touch-icon (the icon pipeline already produces fixed sizes).
